Some inherited from spawner enemy }} ==Description== The '''Corpse''' is an enemy that only appears when spawned through the [[Corpse (Attribute)|Corpse]] attribute. Uniquely, its statistics are actually heavily based on the enemy that summoned it, instead of having its own statistics, though it does have some statistics that do not change. This is because the '''Corpse''' is not its own enemy, it is actually the enemy it spawned from with a changed display name and altered statistics. Most notably, it has 100% defense, and it has the [[Corpse (Attribute)|Corpse]], [[Stun Immunity]] and [[Burn Immunity]] attributes. Its health is 75% of the enemy that it spawned from. Additionally, some of the attributes the enemy it spawned from are also inherited. The only exception to this is [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]], which is removed upon the enemy's death. ==Appearance== The '''Corpse''' does not have a consistent appearance, as the model it uses is based on the enemy it spawned from, though it does have certain characteristics which are consistent between them all. The '''Corpse''' is the body of the enemy it spawned from made entirely out of black molten rocks. Any images present on the enemy, such as faces, will remain on them even as a '''Corpse'''. ==Strategy== *The '''Corpse''' is not a threatening enemy, as it cannot move to the entrance, meaning losing to it is impossible. Its main purpose is to act as a shield for enemies behind it. **However, it can be relatively annoying with its 100% defense and tendency to distract towers from attacking actual enemies. **Towers like the [[Electroshocker]] or [[Toxic Gunner]] can be used to drop its defense, as it is very high. The [[Pyromancer]] cannot be used since it has [[Burn Immunity]]. **Towers like the [[Ranger]] or [[Mortar]] can be used to take care of any corpses that are too far away from your main defenses with their high range. *The '''Corpse''' is required to be killed before a match can end. **Waves can be skipped while only '''Corpses''' are on the path, as that still grants the wave clear bonus. Additionally, infinite waves cannot be skipped at all. ***If you have the [[DJ Booth]], you can exploit this by repeatedly using its ''Drop The Beat'' ability on Green track to make as much cash as you want. *As the '''Corpse''' is technically not a unique, summoned enemy, but instead the slightly altered version of the enemy it spawned from, the [[Cowboy]] is able to generate cash from it. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Variants}} MoltenCorpseMolten.png|First version (11 December 2024 – 12 March 2025) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} The Takeover Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Corpse''' on a promotional video. Valentines Crate 2026 - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Corpse''' on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Jordan Stayt Skin Teaser - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Corpse''' in the game trailer. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Corpse''' is not actually its own enemy; it is just the enemy it spawned from which has been revived and had its statistics and appearance altered. **A '''Corpse''' of an enemy still keeps the ability of said enemy. ***This can lead to weird things happening, for example, a '''Corpse''' of a [[Warden (Modern Enemy)|Warden]] will be able to move after using its ''Heartfelt Laser'' ability. ***This makes the '''Corpse''' technically have the most amount of abilities in game. *The '''Corpse''' is quite similar and likely inspired from the [[w:c:roblox-tower-battles:Petrified|Petrified]], a ''Tower Battles'' enemy. ==Update History== *'''11 December 2024''' - [[v1.45.0]] **'''Molten Corpse''' added. **{{Bug}} [[Jester]]'s defense dropping does not reduce '''Molten Corpse's''' defense. **{{Bug}} '''Molten Corpse''' is sometimes impossible to kill, softlocking the game. **{{Bug}} '''Molten Corpse''' will start for some enemies start moving if their non-'''Molten Corpse''' forms was killed during an ability. Once that ability ends as a '''Molten Corpse''', it will begin walking. *'''11 December 2024''' - [[v1.45.0|v1.45.1]] **{{Bugfix}} '''Molten Corpse''' no longer has a chance to be impossible to kill. *'''12 March 2025''' - [[v1.57.0]] **Name changed from ''Molten Corpse'' to ''Corpse''. **Appearance changed. {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Molten]] [[Category:Fallen]] [[Category:Pizza Party]] [[Category:Badlands II]] [[Category:Polluted Wasteland II]] [[Category:Molten Arena PVP]] [[Category:Ducky Revenge Event]] [[Category:The Takeover Event]] [[Category:Halloween 2025 Live Events]] [[Category:Backyard Beginnings]] [[Category:Competition Court]] [[Category:Victory Field]] {{DISPLAYTITLE:Corpse}} [[Category:Early-Game]]
